605:t_019:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That mouth of yours sure runs on, doesn't it?」

605:t_019:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you're an enemy of the $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_019:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll deal with you before $c, Advent! And then you, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$!」

605:t_019:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's the one thing I agree on, $$サイデリアル$$.」

605:t_020:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you $$アムブリエル$$? Or $$西条涼音$$?」

605:t_020:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You shouldn't say such tactless things to a lady!」

605:t_020:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior of salvation, traveler to $$太極$$, guardian of the law, keeper of causality, cursed wanderer...」

605:t_020:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you too, just like them, choose the path of defying me.」

605:t_020:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Vanish at the end of causality!」

605:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Her existence has been extinguished. There is no need for two Reactors of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

605:t_023:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you $$アムブリエル$$? Or $$西条涼音$$?」

605:t_023:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You shouldn't say such tactless things to a lady!」

605:t_023:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior of salvation, traveler to $$太極$$, guardian of the law, keeper of causality, cursed wanderer...」

605:t_023:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you too, just like them, choose the path of defying me.」

605:t_023:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Vanish at the end of causality!」

605:t_024:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Amazing...! To be able to react to that attack...!」

605:t_024:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is this the result of that special training, too!」

605:t_024:5.en:
$n
(Nobody... has noticed... that this... is a repeat of what just happened...)

605:t_024:6.en:
$n
(Am I the only one... who knows time went back...!?)

605:t_024:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...$n.... You have opened the forbidden door.」

605:t_024:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So that's what the $$いがみ合う双子$$ means...」

605:t_024:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It was worth coming here.」

605:t_024:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Huh...? I haven't even done anything yet...」

605:t_024:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That sense of wrongness from earlier...」

605:t_024:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What happened, $$アウストラリス$$!?」

605:t_024:13.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「We're withdrawing. First, we'll assess the situation.」

605:t_024:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If you say so, I'll obey.」

605:t_024:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What are you saying!? If we leave that Advent alone any longer...」

605:t_024:18.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「The chance will come soon. We'll decide everything then.」

605:t_025:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In that instant... did all twelve $$スフィア$$s become one to deny me...」

605:t_025:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's a shame, $$アサキム$$.」

605:t_025:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You really are different from me.」

605:t_025:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You, too, are my target.」

605:t_026:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I see... So that is your choice.」

605:t_026:3.en:
???
「He's not the only one who won't follow you!」

605:t_027:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's been a long time since I sat in this seat.」

605:t_027:1.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$!? How on earth did you get here!?」

605:t_027:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Teleportation. It's something like an enhanced version of your $$ブーストアップ$$, $n.」

605:t_027:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「My other self is saying it. Thank you for saving her.」

605:t_027:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She and I became one. Yes... just as you overcame hope and despair, $n.」

605:t_027:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The main personality is me, though.」

605:t_027:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You acknowledged her, and at the same time you saved me, who was sinking to the bottom of my consciousness. That's why we could become one.」

605:t_027:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Show me too, $n. Your power... the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

605:t_028:0.en:
$n
「This power...! It surpasses any $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ so far!」

605:t_028:3.en:
$n
「You took my father's and my sister's lives and shot Miss $$スズネ$$. You're my enemy!」

605:t_031:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...$n.... This power is the same as the one you used.」

605:t_031:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Not that I can use it over and over in my current state.」

605:t_031:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Playing dead again, your old specialty!」

605:t_031:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then we'll just have to crush you completely!」

uncertain: 605:t_027:9 compressed to fit (dropped 'existence', 'the two of us').

605:t_022:1: Advent 'two Reactors of the $$いがみ合う双子$$' - Reactor left plain English.
605:t_031:4: Sousuke's 'crush you completely' assumes Advent is the target (Alto's line before is also aimed at him).
Speaker lines: picked #pilot variants for アドヴェント and 尸空 throughout.
